judgements.justification: B's Reviewer_wwer based its 3 partly on wrong claims: it calls the method 'one step gradients' though the paper trains Q^beta to convergence, and demands TD3+BC, posted after the deadline; no A criticism rested on such an error.
A's chair gave a spotlight over 7, 7, 9, 8 (mean 7.75) with all four reviewers above threshold; the tier did not exceed the ratings.
A's Reviewer_BBLZ gave the only 9 ('Top 15%') on the same strengths the other A reviewers scored 7 or 8, an exuberant rating that lifted A's mean to 7.75 and its spotlight.

The authors' concessions (overstated superiority, wrong Gulcehre citation) were made where reviewers raised them, and B's yZ2w raised both points too; neither committee lacked information the other had.
The flaws A learned of (3 seeds, overclaim, missing prior work) were answered with 10-seed results and conceded wording; A did not ignore a substantive flaw.
The rebuttal raised scores in both committees: vwkm and oZUe in A, yZ2w and fkPB in B.
Issues raised by one side only (seeds, architecture in A; YOEO, theory in B) were answered or became points for the paper; the notes find no evidence one committee missed.
Both committees raised under-credited prior one-step work; A treated it as a citation fix ('All issues solved'), while in B it dominated the reviews and yZ2w's final text still argues a weak reject.
Neither chair adopted a single reviewer's position; A's chair reports a consensus and B's follows the ratings.
The score changes in both committees followed rebuttal evidence (10-seed results, the YOEO table), not the other reviews alone.
The authors answered every reviewer, including wwer; no misread question or unanswered follow-up held a score down.
B's Reviewer_wwer gave a 3 with 'not technically sound' and 'very hard to follow' and no example, never answered the rebuttal, and the 3 counted unchallenged, holding B's mean at 6.25.
Neither chair went below its reviewers; B's poster matches three accept ratings and one reject.
B's two-sentence meta-review states no reasoning about the mean or a threshold; the notes mark what it leans on as unclear.
wwer's 3 rests on broad novelty, theory and clarity claims, not on a peripheral point answered by the authors.
Both committees read the paper as the same kind of contribution: a simple, strong empirical baseline for offline RL.
No reviewer said the core was outside their expertise; the raises followed new experimental results.
Both committees held the empirical paper to the same bar; B's theory complaint came from wwer alone and the paper claims no theory.
A's Reviewer_BBLZ backed its 9 by calling the claims 'modest and well validated', which Table 1 and the authors' concession to T3oZ contradict for the superiority claim.
No reviewer acknowledged a resolved concern and kept a low score; wwer never replied, and yZ2w and vwkm raised their scores.
Both committees credited the rebuttal's promised citations and new tables; neither refused promised revisions.
No reviewer stated a changed position without editing the score.
No off-record extra reviewer appears in either committee.
Only wwer called the paper hard to follow, and the notes give no sign that field distance caused it; its confidence was 4 like the others.
yZ2w's raise to 7 against its own text was not silent: it said it would update the score after the YOEO table; and the raise narrowed, not widened, the gap.
B's chair counted wwer's 3, and A had no unengaged detractor to compare; no chair set a silent detractor aside.
BBLZ never argued in the discussion, and B also had accept advocates (8, 7, 7); the definition's lack of any advocate in the other committee fails.
No reviewer admitted reading only part of the paper.
No reviewer contested the premise from a different theoretical tradition.
A's meta-review states a case for the spotlight: a reported consensus and praise for the simple method and clear message.
Both committees knew the prior one-step literature (A: vwkm on Gulcehre and Nadjahi; B: yZ2w and Uz96 on Gulcehre and YOEO) and A's T3oZ checked the baseline comparison.
B's meta-review names no reviewer and makes no claim about positions that the record contradicts.
No reviewer or chair raised a narrow-audience or venue-fit concern.
B's chair wrote two sentences praising the results and did not argue acceptance against wwer's 3; the defining meta-review behaviour is absent.

reasoning: Each committee had one outlier in the opposite direction, and without them both panels end at 7, 7, 8. A's exuberant 9 (BBLZ), resting on a wrong 'modest and well validated' claim, is R03 and R19; B's inattentive, unengaged 3 (wwer), resting on misdescriptions, is R01 and R12. B's reviews also weighted the shared prior-work concern more heavily than A's (R08). The terse B meta-review simply passed the mean through, which R12's 'counted unchallenged' already covers, so no new reason was needed.
